law.text: It is unlawful for any person to drive or operate a vehicle of any kind or character at: A rate of speed greater than that posted by a public authority for the particular portion of highway being traversed.

comparisons.description: One physical SPEED LIMIT 30 sign per original; mph units and public authority are explicit synthetic assumptions. All 30 s / 600 frame histories and every threshold crossing are retained.
